text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...N-No... Your skin is so rough... Why 
did this—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... because I've been 
neglecting my diet lately...?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Every race was so thrilling, I was 
completely absorbed... and I ended up 
neglecting my meals...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...T-This isn't good enough, is it? I've 
got to properly fix this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Chrono Genesis's rough skin just 
wouldn't seem to clear up...
